cosy-teacher-notes.p: Stage aim: to introduce the topic and clarify key target vocabulary for the session.

cosy-slide.cosy-instruction: Révisez le vocabulaire clé de la session ci-dessous :

cosy-blockquote.p: l'avaricie (f.) – (noun) le souci excessif d'économiser l'argent au détriment du confort.

p.em: Example: François Gautier pousse l'avaricie jusqu'à couper l'électricité chez lui.

cosy-blockquote.p: la dissimulation – (noun) l'action de cacher ses possessions et sa fortune aux autres.

p.em: Example: Il pratique la dissimulation de son épargne pour éviter de payer.

cosy-blockquote.p: le lien filial (m.) – (noun) la relation affective unissant un père à sa fille.

p.em: Example: François découvre la chaleur du lien filial en accueillant sa fille Laura.

cosy-blockquote.p: l'obsession (f.) ≠ l'indifférence (f.) – (noun) la fixation mentale sur l'argent opposée à l'absence de préoccupation.

p.em: Example: Son obsession pour le sou près s'oppose à l'indifférence de ses collègues.

cosy-blockquote.p: l'économie extrême (f.) – (noun) la gestion financière poussée jusqu'à l'absurde.

p.em: Example: L'économie extrême de François provoque des situations comiques irrésistibles.

cosy-blockquote.p: le radin / la radine – (noun/adjective) une personne excessivement avare et chiche.

p.em: Example: François est connu comme le plus grand radin de l'orchestre.

cosy-blockquote.p: gratter – (verb) chercher à économiser de petites sommes de manière mesquine.

p.em: Example: Il cherche toujours à gratter quelques centimes sur chaque achat.

cosy-blockquote.p: la radinerie – (noun) le défaut de celui qui est excessivement attaché à l'argent.

p.em: Example: Sa radinerie légendaire lui isole de tous ses voisins.

cosy-blockquote.p: le banquier – (noun) le conseiller financier chargé de la gestion des comptes.

p.em: Example: Son banquier hallucine devant le montant de son compte d'épargne inutilisé.

cosy-blockquote.p: le calculateur / la calculatrice – (noun/adjective) une personne qui prévoie tout avec intérêt et précision.

p.em: Example: Il se montre calculateur dès qu'il s'agit de partager l'addition au restaurant.

cosy-teacher-notes.p: Stage aim: pair/group discussion on core session themes.

cosy-slide.cosy-group-instruction: En binôme ou en sous-groupe, discutez des questions suivantes :

ol.li:
How does the opening of 'Radin' show the idea of extreme saving behavior? Practice with le Conditionnel Présent (Frugality).
★ If you were in 'Radin', how would you handle the challenges of extreme saving behavior?

How does the director introduce hiding wealth early in the movie? Focus on le Conditionnel Présent (Frugality).
★ Have you ever faced a problem where you had to deal with hiding wealth?

As the story goes on, does daughter connection create problems for François Gautier? Frame your answer with le Conditionnel Présent (Frugality).
★ Does the way the movie shows daughter connection feel like real life to you?

How do the scenes in 'Radin' show obsession between the main characters? Use le Conditionnel Présent (Frugality).
★ How do you personally keep obsession in balance in your life?

How does François Gautier react to the challenge of économie extrême? Discuss using le Conditionnel Présent (Frugality).
★ If you could change one decision made by François Gautier about économie extrême, what would it be?

What clues and secrets about 'radin' can you find in the movie? Use le Conditionnel Présent (Frugality).
★ Have you ever used a word or expression like 'radin' in your own life?

How does the script use the expression 'gratter' to make the scene more interesting? Respond with le Conditionnel Présent (Frugality).
★ Do you think learning casual words like 'gratter' is helpful for fluency?

How does using 'radinerie' show the characters' real feelings during hiding his extreme, obsessive saving behavior and wealth from Laura? Formulate with le Conditionnel Présent (Frugality).
★ Is there an equivalent word in your language for 'radinerie'?

How does learning the truth about 'banquier' change what you think of the characters? Analyze with le Conditionnel Présent (Frugality).
★ When you want to express a feeling, do you use slang or direct words like 'banquier'?

If they knew the truth about 'calculateur' earlier, how would the story change? Speculate using le Conditionnel Présent (Frugality).
★ What is your favorite line of dialogue from the movie 'Radin'?

cosy-teacher-notes.p: Stage aim: deeper debate and statement evaluation in pairs/groups.

cosy-slide.cosy-group-instruction: En binôme, débattez et exprimez votre accord ou désaccord sur ces affirmations :

ol.li:
'François Gautier's story of extreme saving behavior in 'Radin' is very sad, and they should be more careful.' Do you agree? Use le Conditionnel Présent (Frugality).
★ If you were a director, how would you show the concept of extreme saving behavior?

'François Gautier's movie makes the world look too beautiful, but it has a high cost.' Discuss using le Conditionnel Présent (Frugality).
★ Do you think the visuals of a movie are more powerful than the dialogue?

'François Gautier is not a nice person because they only care about daughter connection.' Give your opinion using le Conditionnel Présent (Frugality).
★ Have you ever felt that a movie's alternative ending would be better?

'François Gautier's movie 'Radin' is too simple and does not show deep feelings about obsession.' Talk about this with le Conditionnel Présent (Frugality).
★ If you could choose a song from your life to match the theme of obsession, what would it be?

'François Gautier's problem of hiding his extreme, obsessive saving behavior and wealth from Laura never ends because they cannot agree on économie extrême.' Explain using le Conditionnel Présent (Frugality).
★ What was the most memorable scene in 'Radin' that made you think?

'The film would be better if the director chose a different setting for 'Radin'.' Speculate using le Conditionnel Présent (Frugality).
★ Would you ever want to write a story based on your own life experiences?

'The secondary characters, like his long-lost daughter Laura, and his music school colleagues, are more interesting than the main hero.' Evaluate with le Conditionnel Présent (Frugality).
★ Which part of filmmaking (music, camera angles, lighting) has the biggest effect on you?

'The music and sound design are what make 'Radin' a great movie.' Discuss using le Conditionnel Présent (Frugality).
★ If you could change the cast of 'Radin', which actors would you choose?

'The recurring visual symbols are important to understand the film's deeper meaning.' Discuss using le Conditionnel Présent (Frugality).
★ Do you enjoy analyzing movies or do you prefer to just watch the story?

'The story of 'Radin' is a critique of real-world human behavior.' Discuss using le Conditionnel Présent (Frugality).
★ If you could save only one scene from 'Radin', which one would it be?

p.cosy-text: Notes de correction linguistique du professeur:

ul.li: Incorrect: He gave to her a beautiful book → Correct: He gave her a beautiful book (Direct object doesn't require 'to' after 'give' in English.)
Incorrect: The boss is more demanding than what I thought → Correct: The boss is more demanding than I thought (Exclude 'what' in comparative thought comparison clauses.)
Incorrect: I will resign if they skimp always on budget → Correct: I will resign if they always skimp on budget (Frequency adverbs like 'always' come before the main verb.)

cosy-slide.cosy-instruction: Bilan et retours : révisez les corrections linguistiques clés avec votre professeur.
